ABOUT ASA EPC

Concept to commissioning, under one roof.

ASA EPC PVT LTD is a DPIIT-recognised renewable energy company delivering residential, commercial, and industrial solar systems, IPP, asset management, and power transmission. As a franchise partner of Waaree Energy — India's largest vertically integrated energy company — every project draws on a supply chain built for scale and reliability.

02 — TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION

What's going into the ground.

Component-level specification for the project.

No. Item Specification
1Solar PV ModulesP max ≥ 615 Wp, N-Type Bi-Facial
2Mounting StructuresSeasonal tilt 5–20°, HDGI (for RCC) + Galvanum, min. 500mm clearance
3InverterOutdoor string inverter, min. 98% efficiency (SG320HX20), multi-rated 300–352 KVA
4Combiner BoxesDust / water-proof with applicable protection features
5DC Solar CablesSolar grade, halogen-free, UV & weather resistant
6AC LT Cables3-core aluminium XLPE insulated, galvanised steel armoured
7Earthing SystemChemical, maintenance-free type
8Lightning ArrestorESE type, 120m radius coverage, per industry standards
9ACDBDust-proof, over-current and surge protection, IP65
10Remote MonitoringWeb-based, with data logger & SCADA system
11Substation & Yard800/33KV pulling substation, 10MVA transformer, breaker, isolator, metering unit
12Transmission Line33KV overhead, 'H'-beam 13m structure, Dog conductor
13Injection Bay & Metering33KV injection bay at HT side of substation, with metering unit

06 — WARRANTY

Backed long after handover.

Manufacturing defect and performance warranty by component.

Solar Modules

30 yrs

Product warranty against manufacturing defect and poor workmanship. Performance warranty: 90% rated output at year 10, 80% at year 30.

Inverter

5 + 25 yrs

Standard 5-year manufacturer warranty, extendable up to 25 years.

Mounting Structure

25 yrs

Structural warranty covering the full module mounting system.

Other BOS

As per OEM

Balance-of-system components covered as per original equipment manufacturer terms.
